messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] qq plots
parts:
This message is produced by Distance to prevent the QQ-plot from becoming over-crowded; it is not an error message.  All observations will be included in the calculation of the goodness of fit tests, just not all points will be shown on the QQ-plot  The maximum number of points on the QQ-plot can be adjusted in the "Diagnostics" button in the "Detection function" tab in the CDS and MCDS analysis engine.  The analysis engine can be accessed from the "Model Definition Properties".

See the screen capture I provide along with this email.
